This book is generally considered to be a conspiracy tome, but if you're into deep politics and the deep state (which is close to, but distinct from, conspiracy theory) it's unbelievable how much some of the stuff he mentions here comes up.

The book centers on the Son of Sam Killings, and that David Berkowitz was not the only person doing the killings. That in fact, he was part of a cult- The Process Church of the Final Judgment (this was a real cult, although its involvement in SoS is still speculative) which in turn was part of a larger network of cults which are used by deep state elements such as the CIA to do its dirty work. Everything from domestic assassinations to general Gladio-esque operations to push society towards authoritarianism.

As I said, most would consider this to be speculative, however, looking objectively at the Son of Sam case, it seems that Berkowitz *couldn't* have been the only perp, as the killings continued after his arrest. However, the NYPD, dealing with political pressure and a panicked populace, pinned the blame on Berkowitz, who was more than happy to take it to cover up for his accomplices. As for the rest of it, that's up to you to decide, should you choose to read it.

Although this book is out of print, I found a torrent of a PDF of it on TPB. I expect you can probably find it on most torrent sites if you're interested.
